stem: How does the purpose of the organizational structure in the excerpt from “Music and the Maestro” DIFFER from that in the story “Saturday Surprise”?

options.label: A
options.text: The author of the excerpt uses categorization to reveal what different students learned from Morgan, whereas the author of the story uses chronological order to highlight the interactions between Logan, Jamie, and the other kids on the court.

options.label: B
options.text: The author of the excerpt uses categorization to show different periods of Morgan’s life as they relate to music, whereas the author of the story uses chronological order to describe how events progress over the course of a morning for Logan.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of the excerpt uses categorization to emphasize Morgan’s achievements, whereas the author of the story uses chronological order to create sympathy for Logan.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of the excerpt uses categorization to outline the skills Morgan excelled at, whereas the author of the story uses chronological order to focus on Logan’s limited skills.
